slots.title: The Three-Port Relief Circuit 1/3 — Seal the Ceres Ration Lot
slots.description: Quartermaster Mara Venn: Ceres ration reserves are below one shift; Venn needs food delivered without creating a panic bid. Take 10u sealed provisions from Helios to Ceres Refinery. Do not divert the manifest. Failure: Loss of custody forces Ceres onto spot-market rations. Recovery: Return to Helios; Venn can reseal a smaller lot. No unresolved wreck cause is required; the regional ecology is the standing evidence.
